title: structured-output: add CFG + regex constrained-decoding backends and tokenizer edge-case handling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: structured output users need reliable constrained decoding across diverse backends and tokenizers. This PR introduces two constrained-decoding backends (CFG/grammar and regex NFA-based) plus a compatibility layer to handle tokenizer edge-cases (Unicode, byte-level token splits, and tokenizer-regex mismatches). Summary of changes: 1) runtime/constrained_backends: new cfg_backend and regex_backend with pluggable interface and deterministic prefix filtering; 2) runtime/tokenizer_compat: normalization and token-span mapping helpers to ensure constraints align with token boundaries; 3) api/structured_output: exposed new "backend" option (cfg|regex|legacy) and strict_token_alignment flag; 4) openai-compat: map OpenAI "logit_bias" + schema constraints into backend-compatible representations; 5) tests/e2e: added fuzz tests for Unicode/regex interplay and regression tests for previously observed failures. Implementation notes: CFG backend compiles a context-free grammar into a constrained state machine that interacts with the token-level prefix search to efficiently prune expansion. Regex backend compiles user regexes into an NFA/dfa hybrid with safe fallback to byte-level matching when token boundaries are ambiguous. Tokenizer compatibility introduces normalization steps (NFC) and a token-to-string mapping table so constraints operate on canonical strings while still referencing token indices. Backwards compatibility: default remains legacy behavior; new behavior gated behind explicit API option and a feature-flag for hosted customers. Testing and validation: unit coverage for new backends, integration tests that run on mainline tokenizers (sentencepiece, bpe, tiktoken-like), and a canary rollout to 5% of hosted traffic. Performance: measured end-to-end generation latency increase 3-7% for complex grammar constraints; memory overhead modest (per-request state ~200-500KB when using CFG backend). Risks and mitigation: possible regex catastrophic backtracking mitigated by NFA compilation with explicit timeouts and max-depth guards; tokenizer mismatch warnings surfaced in API response when strict_token_alignment detects ambiguous spans. Checklist: - [x] code + unit tests - [x] e2e regressions and fuzz harness - [x] docs + API changelog entry - [x] feature flag for rollout - [x] add telemetry for constraint-failures Related work: LIN-ENG-1142, ENG-2019, DOC-58. release_notes: Adds two new constrained-decoding backends (CFG and regex), tokenizer compatibility helpers to reduce constraint/tokenization mismatches, new API option `backend` (cfg|regex|legacy), and telemetry for constraint failures. Backwards compatible by default; opt-in via API flag.
